BackstoryDef.title: goblin child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a newly born goblin already scrambling toward maturity. [PAWN_pronoun] has not lived long enough to earn a proper childhood story yet.

BackstoryDef.title: tribe-born
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born from a brood female owned by a goblin tribe. Like the father, not a trace of the mother can be found - just ugly goblin blood, all the way down.

BackstoryDef.title: pit-born
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent the first day crammed into a breeding pit, tangled up with other newborns in the corner of a raiding camp. Nobody bothered to figure out who was whose sibling.

BackstoryDef.title: quarry pup
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] opened [PAWN_possessive] eyes in a pit beside a quarry. Before learning to walk, [PAWN_pronoun] had already learned to feel out cracks in stone with [PAWN_possessive] fingertips.

BackstoryDef.title: cauldron-side runt
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up helping out around the cauldron fire. The smell of hot steam and charred meat is the most familiar scent [PAWN_pronoun] has ever known.

BackstoryDef.title: slaughterhouse assistant
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up playing with severed scraps from the slaughterhouse. Picked up some basic anatomy along the way. Hard to say whether the knife work came from cooking or something else.

BackstoryDef.title: arrow bait
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was part of a group of young goblins used as arrow fodder to probe enemy defenses. Everyone else caught something - an arrow, a bolt, a spear. [PAWN_nameDef] was just fast enough.

BackstoryDef.title: shaman's aide
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] assisted the priest of the flesh-consuming faith from an early age, learning the doctrine before most goblins had even heard of it. [PAWN_pronoun] was the first to believe - truly believe - that it was possible to become human.

BackstoryDef.title: child slave
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s tribe was raided by another goblin faction not long after birth. Young goblins usually get abandoned or eaten - but [PAWN_nameDef] was lucky enough to end up as a slave instead.

BackstoryDef.title: young raider
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is the survivor of a group of young goblins sent as arrow fodder to test enemy defenses. Most got caught between the enemy in front and their own kin behind. [PAWN_nameDef] was lucky.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin spearman
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] holds the front line, reach weapon forward. Specializes in stopping cavalry charges from Mousie knight orders.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin light infantry
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served in the raiding parties as light infantry - flanking runs, line bypasses, hit-and-loot. Travel light, hit fast.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin meat shield
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was trained to hold a line and absorb hits with a cheap blade and a shoddy shield. That's the whole job.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin swordsman
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] takes pride in the blade. Any fool who challenged [PAWN_pronoun] to a duel got a split skull. No card tricks. No ceremony.

BackstoryDef.title: crossbow shooter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] handles ranged duty. Happy to prove the point in person.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin musketeer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served in the line infantry, firing in controlled volleys on the signal pheromone from the range coordinator.

BackstoryDef.title: firearm tinkerer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] maintains and loads the early firearms. Small hands turn out to be useful for precision part work.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin powder miner
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] handles blast mining full-time.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin heavy infantry
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was part of the heavy infantry corps - well-equipped and drilled. Held position when the retreat pheromones sent everyone else scrambling.

BackstoryDef.title: raiding vanguard
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] hits the enemy formation first, before anyone else. Rotates out often. The record is the most decorated in the squad.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin kidnapper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] always half-participated in the raid and spent the real effort scouting kidnap targets. Always ran first. Still alive.

BackstoryDef.title: human hunter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] tracked escapees and hidden females through the forest on scent alone. Didn't miss often.

BackstoryDef.title: tunnel construction slave
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was taken captive by a rival goblin mob and put to work as a tunnel slave - digging the shaft and being the first one shoved into it when it was ready.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin slave soldier
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was pressed into another mob's raids as a slave soldier. Sometimes offered freedom as the condition for a suicide run.

BackstoryDef.title: raid squad leader
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] commands a squad of five to seven. Every one of their lives depends on [PAWN_possessive] next call.

BackstoryDef.title: skin mask shaman
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] presides over the flesh-consuming rites wearing a mask made from human skin. Leads the ceremony.

BackstoryDef.title: human mimicker
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is completely consumed by the belief that becoming human is possible. Questions that belief at your own risk.

BackstoryDef.title: beacon pilgrim
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] travels from beacon ceremony to beacon ceremony and won't settle anywhere. Doesn't take instructions to stay.

BackstoryDef.title: stab stab goblin
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] stabs once. If the target doesn't go down, [PAWN_pronoun] stabs again. No other tactical knowledge. Doesn't need it.

BackstoryDef.title: laughs while running
BackstoryDef.description: 'WHY LAUGHING?? RUNNING IS FUN!! IF YOU GET CAUGHT YOU STOP LAUGHING SO I DON'T GET CAUGHT!! KISHI-SSIT!!'

BackstoryDef.title: smells blood first
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] picks up the scent of the wounded and the dead before anyone else in the mob. Finds the dropped loot the same way.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin hunter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] learned to recognize goblin spoor, greasy camp smoke, and the sour stench of their cookfires. When a beacon burns, [PAWN_pronoun] knows what it means.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin raid survivor
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] survived a goblin raid and remembered every scream, every filthy laugh, and every stolen body. The memory hardened into a habit of vengeance.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin exterminator
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] joined punitive expeditions against goblin warrens, learning how to burn burrows, break crude shields, and keep moving when the little things start swarming.
